# Distribution packages

Both files contain the same v6 Skill package, including the Windows pre-launch Guard, handoff command, references, and GitHub self-bootstrap scripts. Use `repair-codex-history.zip` for manual installation or `repair-codex-history.skill` when the Codex client supports direct Skill import.
